title: fix(lint): the controlledByParent owner arm prescribes ownerMayEdit only for an owner_id-keyed policy
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XG6dM1MS6FbmME9jADHuk89)_

Fixes #26591

Clause-②: no (lint advice is not a contract face; no accepted metadata shape moves)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`os lint` 的 `security-controlled-by-parent-owner-policy-without-opt-in` 只在策略按 `owner_id == current_user.id` 写、且明细表确有 `owner_id` 列时，才建议加 `ownerMayEdit: true`；按别的人员字段（如 hotclm 的 `owner`）写的策略，不论加没加开关都会提示，并改为建议「把负责人放进 `owner_id`」，不再建议这个开关。
- **为什么改**：运行时的写入门只认行上存的 `owner_id`。以前 lint 对任何人员字段都建议加开关，hotclm 照做后 lint 不响了，但负责人照样被 403 拒绝，等于 lint 在误导。
- **风险与回滚**：只改 lint 的提示文字和触发条件，不动运行时权限门，也不动任何元数据契约；回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts`（新函数 `carriesCbpOwnerColumn`、`pushCbpCallerPolicyOffOwnerColumn` 和规则循环里的 `admittable` 一行）；`packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture-owner-may-edit.test.ts`（新的 #26591 用例组）；`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-security-posture-owner-may-edit.test.ts`，预期全部通过，其中「an other-field policy with the opt-in: still flagged」一条证明加了开关的 `owner` 策略仍会被提示。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`sharing.controlledByParent.ownerMayEdit: true` admits one caller past a `controlled_by_parent` detail's master-write gate. That caller is the user in the stored row's `owner_id` (`assertControlledByParentWrite`), and only on a detail whose registered schema carries that column (`resolveCbpRelation` resolves the opt-in `false` otherwise). The lint arm prescribed the opt-in for any `FIELD == current_user.id` update policy. This PR narrows the advice to the shape the runtime honours. The runtime gate does not change.

| detail | predicate keys the caller on | before | after |
|---|---|---|---|
| carries `owner_id`, no opt-in | `owner_id` (alone or beside another field) | flagged, opt-in prescribed | same |
| carries `owner_id`, opted in | `owner_id` (alone or beside another field) | silent | same |
| carries `owner_id`, no opt-in | only another user field (`owner`) | flagged, **opt-in prescribed** | flagged, the verdict says the opt-in admits only the stored `owner_id`, and the hint says to key the accountable person on `owner_id`. The hint never names the opt-in |
| carries `owner_id`, opted in | only another user field (`owner`) | **silent** | flagged, as above, and the verdict names the declared opt-in |
| no `owner_id` (`ownership: 'business_unit' \| 'org' \| 'none'`, no own `owner_id` field) | anything, `owner_id` included | flagged and opt-in prescribed (no opt-in), or silent (opted in) | flagged, the verdict says it is "a column the detail does not carry", and the hint says to give the detail an `owner_id` column. The hint never names the opt-in |

- **`packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts`.** `carriesCbpOwnerColumn(obj)` answers whether the detail carries `owner_id` the way the runtime does. It reads the spec's injection plan (`injectedColumnsFor`, `resolveInjectedSystemColumns`) or a field the author declared under that name. The arm keeps `{ optedIn, ownerColumn }` per resolving detail instead of a set of details without the opt-in. A predicate whose keyed fields include `owner_id` on a detail that carries it keeps today's behaviour. Any other caller-keyed predicate goes to the new push site, `pushCbpCallerPolicyOffOwnerColumn`, under the same rule id and the same `warning` tier. `callerIdentityKeyedFields` keeps its shape: it already returns field names, and this arm is its only caller.
- **`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`.** The `os explain` entry now says that the opt-in reads only the stored `owner_id`, only on a detail that carries it. It gives a separate remedy for each case.
- **`packages/spec/liveness/object.json`.** The `ownerMayEdit` evidence string described the arm as flagging "an owner-keyed update policy on a detail that has not declared `ownerMayEdit`". After the narrowing that undersells it, so it now describes the narrowed arm, and its `verifiedAt` moves to 2026-10-27. This is an evidence string, not a contract change. The `object.zod.ts` docblock near :3089 ("so the gate and the lint ask one question one way") is still true, because both read the opt-in through `controlledByParentOwnerMayEdit`, so it is unchanged.
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/lint` patch, plus `@objectstack/spec` patch because `liveness/` ships in spec's `files[]`.

## Tests

- `validate-security-posture-owner-may-edit.test.ts` adds a `#26591` group on hotclm's shape (a `controlled_by_parent` detail with its own `owner` user field and `using: owner == current_user.id`):
  - `owner_id` policy without the opt-in: flagged, opt-in prescribed.
  - `owner_id` policy with it: silent.
  - `owner` policy without the opt-in: flagged with the `owner_id` remedy. The hint does not contain `ownerMayEdit`.
  - `owner` policy with the opt-in: still flagged.
  - Mixed `owner || owner_id` policy: prescribed without the opt-in, silent with it.
  - `ownership: org | none | business_unit`, with and without the opt-in: flagged with the owner-column remedy and no opt-in.
  - An author's own `owner_id` field on `ownership: 'none'`: prescribed, then silent.
  - The fixture is key-legal under `ObjectStackSchema`.
- `validate-security-posture.test.ts` meta-tests:
  - The receiver table excuses `detail` (the arm's own fold) and `sharing` (the opt-in's spelling inside the verdict string).
  - `cbpDetails` replaces `cbpDetailsWithoutOptIn` in the plumbing list.
  - The `findings.push` count goes from 18 to 19.
  - A reachability-corpus row drives the new push site with key-legal metadata.

## Acceptance notes

- **ADR-0055 :176 is now partly false.** It says an `update` / `all` policy that keys a field on `current_user.id`, on a detail that has not opted in, "is flagged with the opt-in as the fix". After this PR that holds only for a policy keyed on `owner_id`. The order keeps `docs/adr/**` out of this PR. The report names the line for the seat.
- **Overlap with other PRs.** #26599, the only other PR on `validate-security-posture.ts`, has merged since this branch was cut. It edits the OWD-alias docblocks near :101–:170, and `git merge-tree HEAD origin/main` is clean. The open #26337 and #26628 edit other entries of `rule-explanations.ts`. No hunk is shared.

## Verification

All readings below are on head `816501243`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: `Test Files  166 passed (166)` · `Tests  7395 passed | 5 skipped (7400)`. This run was on the tree before the corpus row and the `detailName` typecheck fix. The two touched suites re-ran on the final tree: `Test Files  2 passed (2)` · `Tests  210 passed (210)`.

<details><summary>Ablation (one, of the narrowing)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `const admittable = detail.ownerColumn && fields.includes(CBP_OWNER_COLUMN);` with `const admittable = true || (…); // ABL26591`. That restores the old behaviour: every caller-keyed predicate takes the prescriptive path, and an opted-in detail is silent.
- The mutation landed: anchor x1 to x0, replacement x0 to x1, blob `f52007d93faf` to `3b0a2d4cd9cb`.
- The two suites went red as expected: `Tests  5 failed | 205 passed (210)`. The 5 failures are both other-field cases (without and with the opt-in) and the three no-`owner_id` cases (org / none / business_unit). Every `owner_id` case stayed green.
- The restore was proven: the blob after restore equals HEAD (`f52007d93faf`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- The lint suites import `./validate-security-posture.js` from `src/`, so no build sat between the mutation and the run.
</details>
